newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hoogovens to stay in aluminium business.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens to stay in aluminium business.

text.p: Dutch steel and aluminium group Hoogovens NV said on Thursday it had no plans to sell or spin off its aluminium business.
"There is no question of that," chairman Maarten van Veen said when asked by reporters if Hoogovens was considering the sale or flotation of its aluminium business.
However, Van Veen said that Hoogovens would be willing to put one or more of its aluminium business units into joint ventures with other companies if that led to mutual benefits.

Van Veen said the aluminium business posted a return on invested capital of some six per cent in 1996, adding that this fell short of Hoogovens' target. The group's steel business posted a return on invested capital of 12 percent last year.
Some analysts have argued that Hoogovens' returns on aluminium have been too low in recent years and that the company would be well advised to sell off the business.
But Van Veen said Hoogovens remained committed to aluminium and would continue efforts to expand in promising market segments such as aerospace and construction.
